ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a phase diagram, with the vertical axis labeled P, representing pressure; the horizontal axis labeled T, representing temperature. There are three phase boundary lines in the figure intersecting at point A. The line segment from A to C is located at the lower left, near the low-temperature, low-pressure region; the line segment from A to D extends upward rather steeply; the line segment from A to B extends toward the upper right. Reasoning: In a phase diagram, two-phase equilibrium corresponds to the boundary line between two phase regions. Solid and gas equilibrium corresponds to the sublimation curve, that is, the solid-gas boundary below the triple point on the low-temperature, low-pressure side. Point A is the intersection point of the three boundaries, that is, the triple point; the boundary located at the lower left of A is AC. Therefore the condition under which solid and gas are in equilibrium corresponds to line segment AC.

raw_record.question_text: On the phase diagram above, which segment corresponds to the conditions of temperature and pressure under which the solid and the gas of the substance are in equilibrium?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the vertical axis is P and the horizontal axis is T, with three phase-boundary segments meeting at point A; the segment from C to A is the lower-left boundary. From the question, look for the boundary where solid and gas are in equilibrium. Apply the phase-diagram rule that solid-gas equilibrium is the sublimation curve, the boundary below the triple point. Since A is the meeting point of the three boundaries and AC is the only boundary below/left of A, select segment AC.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个相图，纵轴标为 P，表示压力；横轴标为 T，表示温度。图中有三条相界线在点 A 相交。A 到 C 的线段位于左下方、靠近低温低压区域；A 到 D 的线段较陡地向上延伸；A 到 B 的线段向右上方延伸。

推理：在相图中，两相平衡对应两相区域之间的边界线。固体和气体平衡对应升华曲线，即三相点以下、低温低压侧的固-气边界。点 A 是三条边界的交点，即三相点；位于 A 左下方的边界是 AC。因此固体和气体处于平衡的条件对应线段 AC。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct phase-diagram boundary identification: it uses the standard mapping of each coexistence curve on a P-T diagram and the visual fact that AC is the low-temperature/low-pressure curve ending at the triple point A.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the graph as a pressure-versus-temperature phase diagram with three curves meeting at A. Identify the labeled segments: AC runs from low pressure/low temperature up to A, AB extends rightward from A, and AD rises steeply upward from A.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording to determine that the requested segment is specifically the solid-gas equilibrium boundary, not a single-phase region or another coexistence curve.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: On a phase diagram, the line where solid and gas coexist in equilibrium is the sublimation/deposition curve, which lies below the triple point and separates the solid and gas regions. The vaporization curve is liquid-gas and the fusion curve is solid-liquid.
